description.value: Accent Inns Kamloops is a BC-owned, family-operated hotel just off Highway 1, positioning it as a natural stop for cyclists travelling between Vancouver and the Rockies. The property markets itself as the bike-friendliest hotel chain in BC through its 'Bike Love' program, which includes bikes-in-rooms, a wash and tuning station, a 37-piece tool kit, and free bike rentals. It is also Rainbow Registered and pet-friendly, making it a notably inclusive stop for touring cyclists travelling with companions.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for Accent Inns Kamloops is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM record on address, phone, and URL. The dedicated bike-friendly page explicitly describes a 'Bike Love' program allowing guests to bring bikes to their rooms, a bicycle wash and tuning station, a 37-piece tool kit, and free bike rentals, while also stating front desk staff can be asked to reserve bike-friendly rooms and suggest cycle routes — confirming both secure storage and staff knowledge. Additional amenities (laundry, Wi-Fi, onsite restaurant) are confirmed directly on the main Kamloops location page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with a well-documented cyclist program and confirmed amenities. Strong inclusion candidate for any cycling tourism directory.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Guests can bring bikes directly to their room ('Love your bike? Bring it to your room. No need to leave it in storage where you can't see it') — confirmed on the bike-friendly page

Laundry.detail: Laundry facilities listed as a property amenity on the main Kamloops page; laundry room also referenced on the bike-friendly page ('a laundry room in case it's not just your bike that needs washing')

Nearby evening food.detail: 'Restaurant onsite' listed as an amenity icon on the main Kamloops location page

Bikes in rooms.detail: Bike-friendly page explicitly states 'Love your bike? Bring it to your room' and that guests can request a bike-friendly room at reservation

Basic tools.detail: Bike-friendly page lists a 'shop-quality, 37-piece tool kit at your disposal to do everything from tire changes and brake adjustments to headset overhauls' plus rags for cleaning

Bike wash / hose.detail: 'Bicycle wash and tuning station with a professional-grade bike stand' listed on the bike-friendly page

Staff know the bike procedure.detail: Website instructs guests to 'ask for a bike-friendly room when you make your reservation' and states front desk staff can suggest cycle routes and reserve bike rental times, indicating trained awareness of cyclist needs

wow_evidence: bikes-in-rooms, a wash and tuning station, a 37-piece tool kit, and free bike rentals

price.label: Mid-range
price.signal: Accent Inns is value-positioned but modern; Kamloops rates ~$140-170, above budget line; notable Bike Love program
